setup.gatherSets: Gather all cards from the following encounter sets: Consternation on the Constellation, Deep Ones, and Sinking Ship.
setup.placeLocations: Put Cargo Room and Open Water into play. Each investigator begins play at the Cargo Room. Set each other location aside, out of play.
setup.takingOnWater: Remove 1 copy of Taking on Water from the game for each player beyond the first.
setup.crateOfGoods: Set the 5 Crate of Goods assets aside. Shuffle the Tablet of Dagon and 2 other random Crate of Goods assets together, and remove the remaining Crate of Goods assets from the game. All 3 cards should be showing only the unrevealed Crate of Goods side, so that players do not know which Crate of Goods is the Tablet of Dagon.
setup.setAside: Set Luther Marsh and each card from the Deep Ones and Sinking Ship encounter sets aside, out of play.
setup.orderEnforcer: Search the gathered encounter sets for 1 copy of Order Enforcer. Spawn it at Cargo Room.
